description:
## Goal

Every map is an immutable sorted sequence with exactly one entry per strict structural key. Construction, replacement, deletion, lookup, iteration, runtime comparison, and strict equality ask one comparison authority. Equal independently allocated tuple, list, nested-map, and binary keys collide and the last input value wins.

## Signal

The map %{{:x, 1} => :first, {:x, 1} => :last} has one entry, and lookup with a freshly allocated {:x, 1} returns :last on interp, JIT, and AOT. The same holds for lists and recursively composite keys. Allocation noise, input order, GC, and cross-heap transport do not change key order or lookup answers.

Quoted-source equality is a different, metadata-erasing relation. Runtime key order is not an order on that quotient: metadata can reverse runtime key order without changing quoted meaning. Quoted expansion retains its existing semantic match, with no new sort, comparator, or reconstruction path.

## Starting defects removed by this cutover

heap/key_cmp.rs ordered composite keys by moving addresses, so independently allocated equal keys remained separate entries. ir_runtime.rs retained a second partial equality/order traversal, widened numeric keys, omitted schema identity, and cloned schema field vectors. GC moved key addresses without sorting. Both comparator authorities are replaced by one borrowed traversal.

Named-struct identity was erased into flattened module strings and impl-target prefixes before runtime. ModuleName now remains typed through source registration, ModuleMap, StructTag, World predicates, retained backend products, interpreter/native/AOT, and SchemaRegistry. Protocol targets have a typed variant on the existing opaque identity axis. No parse/render bridge remains.

## Final authority model

- World FunctionMap owns one typed FunctionDenotation: named module/name/arity, or owner origin plus typed source occurrence and arity. Types and runtime Node share that immutable origin. ClosureDenotationId is an index/equality token, never ordering authority; runtime comparison requires registered typed origins, including equal-ID comparisons.
- The physical CallableDescr identity is function + source arity + ordered capture layouts. It carries no source capture-type vector. Different source annotations may share one physical descriptor.
- Each construction wrapper owns its ordered exact source capture annotations. Runtime construction retains one complete immutable value per lexical capture in source order, including unused fields, zero-lane tuples, and nested callable environments. There is no parallel equality payload.
- Exact target input layouts own invocation ABI requirements, not source annotations or runtime identity. Existing typed decode/encode composition projects the retained environment into those layouts. Carrier precedes structure: a single ValueRef lane may be a nested callable capture rather than a whole boxed callable. ABI width never decides semantic form. Existing source variable types are preserved; the existing codegen coercion authority performs actual box/unbox conversion.
- Runtime closure equality/order is typed source denotation plus captured runtime values, recursively. Wrapper IDs, execution specializations, source type annotations, target input Ty prefixes, and source-union selection do not decide that equality.
- Resources use a typed generative ResourceId on the existing off-heap Resource owner, preserved through stubs, GC, and transport. Stub addresses, payloads, and destructor identity are not authority. ResourceStub is the sole layout-size authority.
- Schema identity is Tuple(arity) or Named(ModuleName). Equal identity must register the same physical layout; the registry enforces that once. Numeric schema IDs only index it. Internal storage schemas are not language values.

Before rejecting the proposed IncomingInputSlot-to-source-shape/SCC subsystem, the existing World input relation, positioned layout products, exact target input layouts, wrapper annotations, and decoder/encoder authorities were audited. The existing target-layout model already expresses invocation requirements. Separating construction annotations from physical descriptors and composing existing layout adapters removes the contradiction without a second source-shape graph, source-union selector, SCC scheduler, or repair authority. Those experiments and the redundant find_value capture experiment were removed.

## Comparator and publication contract

One borrowed TermComparator traverses immutable values using Node and SchemaRegistry with explicit Strict or Widening numeric mode. Strict mode refines mathematical numeric order by kind on ties and preserves signed-zero bit distinction; Widening equates mathematically equal finite numbers. The shared exact i64/f64 helper avoids lossy integer conversion above 2^53 and is used by runtime, interpreter, and native mixed numeric adapters without scalar boxing or Process creation.

Map keys always recurse in Strict mode, even when their containing map values use Widening comparison. Structural kinds and named schemas remain distinct; equal Bitstring and ProcBin contents compare equal. Atom comparison uses registered semantic names, not IDs or rendered labels.

Normalize once at map publication/freeze, with stable last-input-wins collapse. Binary search, put, delete, comparison, and iteration consume that order. Freeze compacts the original allocation; absent deletion preserves the original value and allocates nothing. GC and transport preserve published order.

Published language terms form immutable finite DAGs and contain only finite floats. Checked float construction/ref decoding rejects NaN and infinity before publication; comparison also rejects forged invalid float bits. Low-level cyclic GC reachability fixtures are unpublished collector tests, not language terms. Mutators require exclusive unpublished construction; unfinished map destinations are not comparable. Do not add visited-set allocations, serializers, canonical strings, prevalidation scans, schema-vector clones, repeated normalization, fallback comparators, or graph-repair passes.

## Deterministic work and allocation proof

The final demand-rule A/B measures four distinct workloads:

| Workload | RuntimeDemand body walks |
| --- | --- |
| Take/drop | 1203 -> 1103 |
| Predicate search | 589 -> 596 |
| Range | 242 -> 225 |
| Reduce operator | 32 -> 31 |
| Total | 2066 -> 1955 (-111) |

All fact applications fall 8479 -> 8412; RuntimeDemand completions and wakes each fall by 67. ExecutableFacts applications remain 817, frontier starts 516, blocked starts 3130, with zero scans or unsanctioned starts. Predicate's seven extra walks are necessary late exact-edge work formerly concealed by forbidden construction-retention feedback, not a new executable cone. The existing three-target CLI observation bundle pins 2034 -> 1924 total walks independently in both processes; the fourth workload independently pins its reduction. No extra compiler-observation harness was added.

Preserving native source types enables safe list reuse in the returned-source witness: identical output and shared-return facts, one successful reuse, and heap totals 7 objects/176 bytes -> 6/160.

Map allocation telemetry is corrected, not increased. In the same atom-order fixture, native Map 0/0 -> 1/64 and Other 1/64 -> 0/0, while total remains 45/816. Interpreter remains Map 3/144, Other 0/0, total 46/880. Goldens pin categories and totals; the direct freeze test pins one 64-byte allocation, identical destination, moving-GC lookup, and allocation-free absent deletion. The old claim that native maps escaped the heap was false and is removed.

## Proof and gates

RED-to-GREEN coverage includes independent equal composite map keys/last wins, typed schema display collisions and layout ownership, registered closure origins, finite ingress, exact mixed numerics and signed zero, physical descriptor sharing across capture annotations, complete closure environments, nested capture projections through both runtime-selected branches, and the direct-plus-boxed a_mixed witness. The latter failed because a one-ValueRef-width shortcut skipped capture projection; deleting the shortcut made all three execution doors pass.

The frozen implementation passes full library tests (2011 passed, 6 existing ignored), runtime tests (255), all fixture trials (673), CLI integration (30), and standalone AOT integration (1), plus fmt, diff checks, and workspace all-targets warnings-denied clippy. Documentation covers semantic authorities, physical/source/invocation ownership, maps, any-value storage, quoted equality, and typed module/schema identity.

A fresh ticket-scoped cold adversarial review remains required before the one commit and close. Remove construction debris rather than retaining probes, duplicate tests, deprecated comparator code, or compatibility paths.
title: Make one strict structural comparator own every map-key operation
